display_long_description:
# Jingle Strike VR Bowling

Bowling is easy. Bowling while someone watches, judges, and comments on every throw is not.

Welcome to Jingle Strike VR Bowling.
Take your shot.  Line it up. Release the ball. Try not to get roasted for it.

[media]

**BOWL UNDER PRESSURE**

Every game is shared with a fully animated elf who reacts to everything you do. Good shots, bad shots, complete disasters — nothing goes unnoticed.

[media]

**FEELS RIGHT IN VR**  
Natural motion-based throwing
Easy to pick up, satisfying to master. Built for quick play and repeat sessions

[media]

**VS ELF MODE** 
Take on an opponent who wants to win. Turn-based, competitive, and surprisingly tense.

[media]


**LOCAL PARTY MODE**  Pass the headset and play together. Up to 5 players. Fast, fun, and perfect for groups.

[media]



**ALWAYS CHANGING**  Seasonal updates bring new looks and moods to the lanes throughout the year.

[media]
